name: ZIP Archive Container
requirements: End of Central Directory (EOCD) signature 50 4B 05 06 within bounded 1 MiB window
Central Directory header parsing within max entries (10,000)

name: Microsoft Word Open XML Document (DOCX)
requirements: ZIP container confirmed
[Content_Types].xml parsed within 256 KiB decompressed budget
_rels/.rels parsed within 256 KiB decompressed budget
Package relationship targets main document part with officeDocument relationship type (Transitional or Strict)
Main document part exists in ZIP package
Main document part ContentType matches wordprocessingml.document.main+xml (or template / macroEnabled)
Main document part XML root tag matches w:document within nesting depth budget 64

name: Compound File Binary (CFB) Container
requirements: BOF magic D0 CF 11 E0 A1 B1 1A E1
CFB Header sector shift validation (512 or 4096 bytes)
FAT and Directory sector traversal with cycle detection and bounded read limits

name: Microsoft Word 97-2003 Binary Document (DOC)
requirements: CFB container confirmed
User stream 'WordDocument' exists (type 2 stream, size >= 32 bytes)
FibBase wIdent == 0xA5EC (little-endian at offset 0)
FibBase nFib >= 0x00C1 (little-endian at offset 2, Word 97 and later)
fcMin and fcMac valid character positions (offset 0x20 and 0x24)
